Jaipur Haveli Excavation Yields Treasure of Coins and Silver

During excavation work at an old haveli in Jaipur, a treasure was discovered. Reports indicate the find includes 15 pots filled with gold, 45 kilograms of silver bars, and approximately 10,000 coins. The owner has filed a police case, and authorities are investigating the discovery. Some reports mention villagers searching for treasure at night with torches, with a video of the find going viral.
